fieldValues.title: package-id-uniqueness ignores canonical names
fieldValues.summary: The package-id-uniqueness check compares definition UUIDs but never canonical namespace/name/version, so two definitions sharing a canonical name pass while being indistinguishable to anything that resolves by name. Three real collisions were sitting in the corpus when this was found.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/611 (branch claude/serene-johnson-d6hysd). Scope per the dispatch comment on #584: canonical-name identity scoped by kind (a Field and a Type sharing a name is not a conflict), plus a directory-tree sweep for definition-shaped files no manifest declares (the #592 blind spot), classifying by $schema when version/name are absent. Running the strengthened guard against the live corpus found three more instances of the #592 orphan pattern (srs/package/spec-authoring-core/views/{spec,rationale,unified}-document-view.json) invisible until this unit; deleted, mirroring #592's own resolution. Both gates green; guards-bite covers all nine new cases. Auto-merge armed (gate:auto-merge).
